info.headline: Mahanadi delta: flooding expected at a Naraj flow of 23,940 m3/s
info.description: MAHANADI DELTA - EXPECTED FLOODING FOR A NARAJ FLOW OF 23,940 m3/s (8.5 lakh cusec), lead time 24 h (flow = highest daily flow over 3 days at Naraj, the measure the atlas is fitted on; method: trigger-discharge map, river flow only) Expected flooded land: 218 km2 People living on that land: 25,384 Settlements with at least 10 % of people on flooded land: 24 - near Biridi (1.4 km): about 403 people (70% of 574) at 20.3319 N, 86.0429 E - near Patkura (9.7 km): about 341 people (48% of 704) at 20.3133 N, 86.3615 E - near Bhattasagar Square (7.0 km): about 263 people (16% of 1,613) at 20.6301 N, 86.1248 E - near Choudwar (4.0 km): about 143 people (21% of 694) at 20.5588 N, 85.8918 E - near Patkura (2.7 km): about 129 people (20% of 647) at 20.4002 N, 86.3823 E - near Patkura (1.5 km): about 90 people (32% of 281) at 20.3855 N, 86.3917 E - near Fakirabad (7.2 km): about 89 people (13% of 706) at 20.4445 N, 86.4497 E - near Dhuria (8.6 km): about 76 people (14% of 529) at 20.4610 N, 86.3444 E - near Patkura (9.3 km): about 75 people (28% of 269) at 20.3113 N, 86.3760 E - near Patkura (9.1 km): about 74 people (30% of 253) at 20.3116 N, 86.4309 E - near Gobindpur (2.6 km): about 72 people (28% of 260) at 20.3515 N, 86.0166 E - near Biridi (7.9 km): about 69 people (14% of 481) at 20.2658 N, 86.0652 E - near Bhattasagar Square (5.9 km): about 69 people (17% of 417) at 20.6256 N, 86.1147 E - near Patkura (10.8 km): about 67 people (27% of 247) at 20.3116 N, 86.3447 E - near Nemalo (1.2 km): about 65 people (16% of 414) at 20.4409 N, 86.1674 E Main roads under water: 11.4 km; named sections: Right Puri Main Canal Road 0.8 km Source: Sentinel-1 flood atlas 2017-2026 + GloFAS discharge (IIT Bombay IDP prototype). Not an official warning.
info.instruction: Follow the district administration; keep off flooded roads.
